title: Reload after completed season-2 transfers loses the identity and career entry surfaces
steps: Follow the unchanged three-season CI journey through the committed season-1 score of Daniel 9 / Nik 3 and the completed season-2 transfer flow.
Reload Daniel with browserSessionPersistence retained and the emulator switch reinstalled.
Wait for mainMenu, then wait for CAREER READY in persistentNikDanielPairPanel before continuing the career.
expected: Daniel retains his identity and sees CAREER READY / CONTINUE CAREER after reload, allowing a fresh exact private session to resume season 2.
actual: Run 3 passed 24 checkpoints through J8.2, then timed out after 30000 ms waiting for CAREER READY on Daniel. Daniel was at mainMenu with empty badge and pair panel; Nik remained at transferChallenge with badge NIK and CAREER READY. Both manager error arrays were empty. Runs 1 and 2 never reached this step because J1.1 failed.
root_cause: Likely the same one-shot identity-bootstrap ordering race as finding 1, now triggered by reload. The missing badge and pair panel match the startup-only reproduction. The persistent pair sidecar is initialized only after online identity becomes registered with an accountId (onlinePlayerIdentity.js lines 9 and 21); if identity bootstrap stops before loading its module, remembered-pair UI cannot restore even though browserSessionPersistence survives. This failure does not prove loss of provider or stored career data.
cause_confidence: likely: source and matching DOM evidence; the natural reload failure did not capture the internal bootstrap timer
